title: Share completed Intent review response watching across E2E specs

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.** The maintained completion-provenance spec caught an earlier revision in the published Done review answer captured by the shared historical watcher.

The check covered `SEED-420#share-completed-intent-review-response-watching` at `784fc3e3162e4d307f83b8712796c46505032e5f`. The fixture in `e2e/intent/intent-done-completion-provenance.spec.ts` records an earlier refinement capture and publishes a later trunk completion before selecting the Done story in Intent.

In an isolated checkout, the only fault made `publishedStoryReview` in `dashboard/server/storyReviewPublished.ts` return the completion commit’s first parent in the response’s `completion` field. The browser network trace independently recorded a 200 response to the historical completed story-review request for `SEED-A#a`. Its `kind` was `published`, its `completion` was the earlier commit `80e1f435c02a9d8b37ba1993b3cb46be9464ab70`, and its `landingRevision` still named the fixture’s published completion `4162c961af4aa00cc73b1aab0bc8b5255192bae1`. The maintained assertion `expect(answer).toMatchObject({ kind: "published", completion })` at line 79 failed on that exact mismatch after the shared watcher parsed the answer.

The same focused `npm run --silent test:e2e -- e2e/intent/intent-done-completion-provenance.spec.ts` command selected one Chromium case in each run. The baseline and restored case passed on their first attempts. The faulted case failed on its only attempt at the completion assertion. The restored Git status matched the pre-probe state before and after the final run. The scratch checkout and branch were removed, and the proof records, assertion output, and network trace were retained in `/tmp/open-dough-intent-coverage-420.OAyEzY`.

**Next proof action.** Keep the existing completion assertion for this path.

- **Test runtime:** 68.46 seconds measured from the three Playwright terminal records (35.65 seconds baseline, 15.72 seconds faulted, and 17.09 seconds restored).
- **Human effort:** Unavailable. No separate human effort measurement was collected.
- **Agent effort:** Unavailable. No separate active effort measurement was collected.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 171006 ms (measured), from 1795677264456 to 1795677435462 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

**Wrap-up disposition.** Checked revision `784fc3e3162e4d307f83b8712796c46505032e5f`, verdict Caught, existing assertion retained with no follow-up.
